title: NAF-Bench leaderboard submission metadata
description: Required alongside every submission (submitted as metadata.json). Determines the track and lets results be interpreted and reproduced.

params_billions.description: parameter count in B, or null if unknown/closed

track.description: standard: fixed prompt, single generation, no tools, temp 0; enhanced: CoT/self-consistency/solvers/agents/fine-tuning allowed (must disclose)

external_tools.description: true if a solver/search/tool was called

samples_per_item.description: model calls per prompt (standard track must be 1)

contact.description: optional; may be omitted for anonymity

method_url.description: paper / code / model card link (required for enhanced track)
